data.one_liner: Analyze text for Bluesky Social to detect handles, links, and tags, and generate facets.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools to parse text for Bluesky Social, automatically detecting handles, links, and tags while supporting Unicode grapheme clusters and safe text splitting. It converts detected entities into Bluesky-compatible facets and handles link facade warnings.
use_when: Building a Bluesky client or integration in Dart and Flutter
Extracting handles, links, and hashtags from user input posts
Generating rich-text facets for Bluesky social posts
avoid_when: Building generic non-Bluesky text parsing applications
Needing general Markdown rendering without Bluesky social specific rules
strengths: Automatic detection of handles, links, and tags
Supports Unicode grapheme clusters and safe text splitting
Zero external domain dependencies outside basic networking
weaknesses: Scoped strictly to Bluesky Social text structures
Relies on network calls or a resolver to convert handles to DIDs
